text_literal_defect.explanation: PGPSignature.hashdata encodes a str subject as UTF-8; PGPMessage.message decodes a t literal as latin-1.  PGPy therefore signs and verifies over double-encoded bytes, so its own check passes. Verifiers hashing the literal octets on the wire - including this audit signature_math path and GnuPG - reject the artifact. This is a PGPy text-literal defect, not evidence that literal metadata is signed.
